findings.highlight: not to pass this around to anyone
findings.evidenceJa: 誰にでも回してる訳じゃないぞ
findings.explanation: Takeya says he does not circulate the file to just anyone—Chiaki is a selective recipient—and then reminds her of their promise. The English instead orders Chiaki not to pass the file to anyone, reversing the subject and changing a statement of his discretion into a restriction on her behavior.
findings.japanese:
「言っとくけど、誰にでも回してる訳じゃないぞ。
約束、忘れてないだろうな？」
findings.todokanai: "I don't think I need to remind you not to pass this around to anyone, right? And I don't need to remind you about our promise either, do I?"

findings.highlight: I took on a sort of elder-sister role for the club
findings.evidenceJa: 最初は長女役だけのつもりだった
findings.explanation: Chiaki initially intended to play only the eldest-daughter role in the production. The English turns the dramatic role into the informal social role of being an elder sister to the club, obscuring the acting context and why no castmate could match her.
findings.japanese:
「最初は長女役だけのつもりだったんだけどね。
結局、あたしに合わせられるコが一人もいなくて」
findings.todokanai: "At first, I took on a sort of elder-sister role for the club, you know? But eventually, it became obvious that not a single person could match my level."
